answer: A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The anchor counter is kept in walnut and nebula publishes each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4836 identities would post 765 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
